name: What factors influence the cost of bathroom drywall installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of bathroom drywall installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost depends on bathroom square footage, ceiling height, whether old drywall must be demolished, and the extent of moisture-resistant materials required. Cement backer boards and mold-resistant purple boards cost more per sheet than basic drywall, and specialized waterproof seam tapes add to material costs. Labor complexity also shifts pricing; bathrooms are tight spaces with numerous plumbing cutouts, electrical boxes, and vanity rough-ins that require precision cutting. If water-damaged framing or insulation behind the old drywall needs replacement, repair labor will increase the total investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom drywall costs vary based on room size, board type, the amount of cutting around plumbing fixtures, and whether existing moisture damage requires framing repairs.
